title: New: Capital Fall
description: Capture an enemy's exact capital tile and plunder their gold — they'll be forced to relocate mid-fight.

title: New: Capital Markers
description: Every player's capital now shows on the map as a crown icon — yours in gold, everyone else's in white.

title: New: Forward Base & Supply Lines
description: Attacks weaken the farther they are from your capital. Build a Forward Base to push your supply line closer to the front.

title: New: Directed Attacks
description: Click a target and your troops push that direction instead of spreading evenly along the border.

title: New: Ranked Matchmaking & Friends
description: 1v1 and 2v2 ranked ladders with a real Elo leaderboard, plus a friends list — sign in to play.
